01-chromium-vi-above-limit.json.expectedRejectionReason: water-soluble Cr(VI) of 3.1 mg/kg above the 2 mg/kg limit (REACH Annex XVII, entry 47)

02-unknown-cement-type.json.expectedRejectionReason: cement type not among the 27 products of EN 197-1

03-clinker-ratio-outside-en197.json.expectedRejectionReason: clinker ratio of 85 % outside the 65-79 % range of CEM II/B-V (EN 197-1, Table 1)

04-invalid-strength-class.json.expectedRejectionReason: strength class not defined in EN 197-1

05-28day-strength-below-class.json.expectedRejectionReason: 28-day strength of 39 MPa below the 42.5 MPa lower limit of class 42.5 (EN 197-1, Table 3)

06-malformed-cas-number.json.expectedRejectionReason: CAS Registry Number not in the NNNNNNN-NN-N format

08-undefined-lca-module.json.expectedRejectionReason: module B1 is outside the passport scope (A1-A3, C1-C4)

10-unknown-energy-source.json.expectedRejectionReason: energy source outside the controlled vocabulary

11-passport-uri-not-a-uri.json.expectedRejectionReason: passportURI is not a valid URI and cannot serve as QR content

12-L-class-with-non-CEM-III.json.expectedRejectionReason: low early strength (L) classes apply only to CEM III cements (EN 197-1)

13-cas-check-digit-wrong.json.expectedRejectionReason: CAS Registry Number fails its check digit

15-early-strength-wrong-age.json.expectedRejectionReason: a 2-day early strength cannot show class 32.5N, whose early strength is specified at 7 days (EN 197-1, Table 3)

16-passport-uri-other-batch.json.expectedRejectionReason: passport URI points to a different batch than the batchID

17-other-declared-unit.json.expectedRejectionReason: declared unit other than 1 t cement (fixed in this pilot for comparability)

18-missing-penrt.json.expectedRejectionReason: PENRT missing for module A1 (GWP-total, PERT and PENRT are required for every declared module)

19-missing-early-strength.json.expectedRejectionReason: early strength missing; the strength class is defined by early and 28-day strength (EN 197-1, Table 3)

20-constituent-type-not-in-cement-type.j.expectedRejectionReason: main constituent LL (limestone) declared in a CEM II/B-V cement, whose main constituent is V (EN 197-1, Table 1)

21-composite-cement-with-one-main-consti.expectedRejectionReason: CEM II/B-M declared with only one main constituent besides clinker (two or more required, EN 197-1, Table 1)

22-cem-v-slag-share-too-low.json.expectedRejectionReason: CEM V/A with blast-furnace slag at 10.5 % of the main and minor constituents (18-30 % required, EN 197-1, Table 1)
